description:
## Sibling propagation of canonical bd:JMAP-k9va.1

Depends on bd:JMAP-k9va.1 (mail-server canonical fix) landing first.

Per workspace AGENTS.md 'Canonical Templates' rule, this sibling must mirror the shape mail-server adopts. Read the canonical commit before starting.

## Candidate sites

Audit via:

```
rg -n 'Id::from\(.*str' crate-jmap-filenode-server/src/
```

5 `Id::from` matches as of 2026-05-16. Separate wire-boundary (in scope) from backend-return-value (out of scope) per the .39 / .93 cross-walk:

- Wire-boundary: `/set` update map keys, `/set` destroy array elements, method-arg fields like `chatId` / `spaceId` / `blobId`.
- Out of scope: Ids returned by `get_*` backend calls, synthetic Ids constructed from server-generated content, references to existing entries.

## Acceptance

- Mirror the canonical fix shape from bd:JMAP-k9va.1
- All wire-boundary sites use `Id::new_validated` with appropriate error mapping
- Internal sites carry an inline `// out of scope: <reason>` comment
- `cargo test -p jmap-filenode-server` green
- `cargo clippy -p jmap-filenode-server -- -D warnings` green
- At least one negative test added

## Cross-references

- Canonical: bd:JMAP-k9va.1
- Triggering finding: bd:JMAP-ayoz.39 (metadata-specific) / bd:JMAP-x2gd.93 (chat-specific)
